line: A watch with no battery is cut open: its three systems are dyed one by one, the train races when the escapement is pulled out, and one slowed tick lets it all out again.
line_cn: 剖开一块不用电的表：三套系统按能量流向逐一染色，抽走擒纵后齿轮疯转，最后放慢到 1/40 等那一声滴答。

transitions: Transitions are made inside the object: a cut opening, a lid lifting, layers exploding or landing, a match cut on a mechanical event.
No dissolves, page turns or slides.
labels: Roles: a neutral grotesk for titles and labels (e.g. Inter, 600–650 weight, tight tracking); a monospace in caps with wide tracking for figure lines, readings and units (e.g. IBM Plex Mono); a CJK sans for Chinese (e.g. Noto Sans SC). All OFL, self-hosted.

Three levels only. Primary: a headline (60–64 px) or the label of the part being explained (name ~30 px ink + one 18 px line). Secondary: what was already explained, name ≥ 22 px mid grey, its line greys and lingers before it goes. Tertiary: the figure line (FIG. n · …, 13 px mono grey) and small data tags.

Labels grow out of the part: a leader draws from a dot on the part, a colour dot in the system hue pops, the text slides in. Re-project every frame; when a label would cover a part, pin it to empty space and keep the leader; when the part leaves the frame, the label goes with it.
Comparisons (ratios, before/after): the number is the primary (≥ 120 px), the two ends that produce it are secondary with leaders, all held in frame ≥ 2.5 s.
motion: 24 fps on ones, smooth camera; no stepping.
Motion is driven by one master clock: a smooth speed curve (real time, a fraction of it, deep slow motion, stopped) whose integral moves everything. Speed changes never jump.
Ratios are exact: every wheel's angle comes from the driver through tooth counts; meshing stays meshed (a free-run must end on a whole number of teeth).
Stepped motion (an escapement, a ratchet, an indexing table): the stepped part advances inside a short impulse window; the oscillator is a sine through its centre at each beat.

native_moves.name: Dye by system
native_moves.does: A grey machine takes its colours in the order energy flows.
native_moves.fits: the power path in a drone; the signal chain in a radio; the blood route in a pump.

native_moves.name: Section with hatching
native_moves.does: A wedge or plane cuts the housing; the cut faces hatch in world space.
native_moves.fits: a valve body; a camera lens barrel; a lock cylinder.

native_moves.name: Explode by system, remove one layer
native_moves.does: Layers lift apart; pulling one out shows what it was doing (a motor over-revs without its governor).
native_moves.fits: a brake without its caliper; a router without its clock; a dam without its gate.

native_moves.name: Follow the force
native_moves.does: A low tracking shot from source to sink while the dye travels with it.
native_moves.fits: a bicycle drivetrain; a heat path in a laptop; water through a turbine.

native_moves.name: True slow motion of one contact
native_moves.does: Speed curve down to deep slow motion into a single interaction, silence, then its sound.
native_moves.fits: a shutter curtain; a ratchet pawl; a relay closing.

native_moves.name: Parameter drag
native_moves.does: A control in the accent changes one input; readouts and a small curve recompute from the model (style frame 3 in demo/).
native_moves.fits: aperture vs depth of field; gear ratio vs speed; tension vs amplitude.

native_moves.name: Whole object, still cut open
native_moves.does: The housing returns with the cut kept, the coloured systems running inside.
native_moves.fits: an engine in its car; a heart in its chest; a server in its rack.

score.note: plucked and struck pitched percussion; the mechanism's beat on the grid
